name: Ansel Sofa
description: The Ansel is a low-slung three-seater with a solid walnut frame, tapered legs and a gently bowed back that curves around you. The upholstery is a tight-weave olive wool blend over high-resilience foam and feather-wrapped seat cushions, so it sits firm but softens where it counts. It suits a living room that wants one quiet, confident piece to anchor everything else.
details: W 84 in x D 36 in x H 31 in; seat height 17 in
Kiln-dried hardwood frame with solid walnut legs and arm caps
Wool-polyester blend upholstery, 50,000 double rubs
Feather-wrapped foam seat cushions, reversible
Ships in two boxes; legs attach without tools
Frame made in Vietnam, assembled and inspected in Texas

name: Lund Sofa
description: The Lund is a pared-back two-and-a-half seater on pale ash legs, with slim track arms and deep, loose back cushions in a light grey wool. The silhouette is clean enough to float in the middle of a room and soft enough to disappear into on a Sunday. It belongs in a calm, light-filled space with not much else competing for attention.
details: W 78 in x D 35 in x H 32 in; seat height 18 in
Solid ash legs with a natural matte lacquer
100% wool upholstery, removable and dry-cleanable cushion covers
Foam-core seat cushions with fibre wrap, back cushions fibre-filled
Seats three comfortably; sleeps one guest in a pinch
Made in Lithuania
imageQuery: scandinavian grey wool sofa ash legs

name: Haru Low Sofa
description: The Haru sits just 14 inches off the floor on a wide white-oak platform, with a single long seat cushion and loose back bolsters in a nubby stonewashed linen. The oak is left visible as a shelf along the back, wide enough for a cup and a book. It makes a room feel spare and grounded, and it is built for people who sit cross-legged.
details: W 86 in x D 38 in x H 27 in; seat height 14 in
Solid white oak platform frame, oiled finish
100% linen upholstery, stonewashed, removable covers
High-density foam seat with a latex top layer
Oak back ledge holds up to 15 lb
Made in Portugal

name: Marigold Velvet Sofa
description: The Marigold is a deep-buttoned three-seater in a saturated cotton velvet, with rolled arms, turned beech legs and a tight back that holds its tufting. It comes in a marigold that reads almost orange in afternoon light, a peacock teal and a raspberry pink. It is a sofa for a room with pattern on the walls, art stacked on the floor and no interest in playing it safe.
details: W 88 in x D 37 in x H 33 in; seat height 19 in
Kiln-dried beech frame with turned legs in a dark stain
100% cotton velvet, 40,000 double rubs, spot-clean only
Hand-tufted tight back with 72 buttons
Pocket-sprung seat with foam and fibre topper
Made in Poland

name: Cove Slipcovered Sofa
description: The Cove is a relaxed three-seater wrapped in a loose, machine-washable linen-cotton slipcover with a skirted base and slouchy, overfilled cushions. It comes in white, sand and a soft faded blue, and it only looks better slightly rumpled. It is the sofa for a bright, breezy room where sandy feet and dogs are part of the plan.
details: W 90 in x D 40 in x H 34 in; seat height 19 in
Solid pine and engineered hardwood frame
Linen-cotton slipcover, fully removable, machine washable cold
Down-alternative seat and back cushions, overfilled
Second slipcover available separately in any color
Made in North Carolina

name: Bramble Armchair
description: The Bramble is a generous wingback with a loose seat cushion, a scalloped skirt and a solid pine frame, upholstered in a brushed cotton that comes in cream, sage and a small red gingham. It has the shape of a chair that has been by the fire for fifty years, without the sag. Put it next to a reading lamp and a basket of wool and it looks like it has always been there.
details: W 32 in x D 36 in x H 41 in; seat height 19 in
Solid pine frame with corner-blocked joints
Brushed cotton upholstery, 30,000 double rubs
Foam seat cushion with feather wrap, fibre-filled back
Matching ottoman available separately
Made in Portugal

name: Orla Bouclé Armchair
description: The Orla is a chunky barrel chair with one continuous curved back, a thick pillowy seat and no visible legs, wrapped in a looped wool-blend bouclé. It comes in cream, burnt orange and a chocolate brown, and it swivels a full 360 degrees on a hidden chrome base. It is round, soft and a little bit groovy, and it makes a corner feel like a place to stay.
details: W 33 in x D 31 in x H 29 in; seat height 17 in
Hidden chrome-plated steel swivel base, 360 degrees
Wool-polyester bouclé, 45,000 double rubs
High-resilience foam seat with fibre wrap
Arrives fully assembled
Made in China

name: Delphine Fluted Armchair
description: The Delphine is a curved tub chair with a vertically channel-stitched back that fans out like a shell, finished with brushed-brass sabots on tapered legs. The velvet is a dense cotton-viscose in emerald, sapphire and a dusty blush. It is polished and a little theatrical, the chair you put at an angle beside a bar cart.
details: W 30 in x D 30 in x H 31 in; seat height 18 in
Solid beech legs with brushed-brass caps
Cotton-viscose velvet, 35,000 double rubs, spot clean
Channel-tufted back with 12 vertical flutes
Foam seat with fibre wrap
Made in Vietnam
imageQuery: emerald velvet channel tufted armchair brass

name: Foundry Leather Armchair
description: The Foundry is a sling-style lounge chair with a top-grain leather seat and back suspended from a blackened steel frame on exposed hex bolts. The leather is full aniline and unprotected, so it scuffs, darkens and takes on a map of where it has been. It is built for a loft with brick, concrete and tall windows, and it only gets better looking.
details: W 28 in x D 33 in x H 30 in; seat height 16 in
Powder-coated blackened steel frame, 1 in square tube
Full-aniline top-grain leather, 3 mm, will patina
Stainless hex-bolt hardware, included wrench
Weight capacity 300 lb
Made in India

name: Hollis Coffee Table
description: The Hollis is an oval coffee table in solid walnut with a surfboard-shaped top, a floating lower shelf and four splayed, tapered legs. The grain runs the length of the top and the edges are softened to a thumb-round profile. It is low, warm and easy to walk around, which makes it good company for a long sofa.
details: W 48 in x D 24 in x H 16 in
Solid American walnut top and legs, hardwax-oil finish
Walnut-veneered lower shelf, 4 in clearance from floor
Weight capacity 80 lb on top, 25 lb on shelf
Legs attach with four bolts; wrench included
Made in Indonesia
imageQuery: oval walnut mid century coffee table

name: Ren Coffee Table
description: The Ren is a low rectangular table in solid oak with a black-stained frame and a natural top, joined with visible through-tenons at each corner. The proportions are wide and squat, 13 inches high, so it reads as a platform more than a piece of furniture. It is quiet, well-made and happiest with a single stoneware bowl on it.
details: W 47 in x D 24 in x H 13 in
Solid white oak, natural oiled top with black-stained base
Exposed through-tenon joinery, no metal fasteners
Weight capacity 100 lb
Arrives assembled
Made in Vietnam
imageQuery: low oak black japandi coffee table

name: Girder Coffee Table
description: The Girder has a two-inch-thick top of reclaimed pine, planed flat but left with its nail holes and saw marks, bolted to a raw steel trestle base with a clear matte sealer. Each top is different because each one used to be a floor joist in a mill somewhere. It is heavy, utilitarian and built to be put your boots up on.
details: W 50 in x D 26 in x H 17 in
Reclaimed pine top, 2 in thick, matte polyurethane
Hot-rolled steel base with clear wax finish, 1/4 in plate
Weight capacity 200 lb
Top and base ship separately; bolts and wrench included
Made in Pennsylvania

name: Soleil Side Table
description: The Soleil is a round drinks table with a white Carrara marble top on a fluted brass column and a weighted brass disc base. The flutes catch lamplight along their whole height, and the marble is honed rather than polished so it does not show every ring. It is small, glossy and exactly the right height beside a velvet chair.
details: Dia 16 in x H 22 in
Honed Carrara marble top, 3/4 in, sealed
Brass-plated steel column and base, fluted
Weight capacity 20 lb
Marble will vary in veining; wipe spills promptly
Made in India

name: Dune Rattan Side Table
description: The Dune is a drum-shaped side table hand-wrapped in natural rattan over a mango-wood frame, with an open cane weave around the sides and a solid wood top. The rattan is left honey-toned and lightly sealed, so it warms with sun and age. It is light enough to move with one hand and happy next to a plant, a pile of books or a bed.
details: Dia 18 in x H 20 in
Hand-woven natural rattan over a solid mango-wood frame
Solid mango-wood top, clear matte lacquer
Weight capacity 25 lb
Weight 9 lb; arrives assembled
Made in Indonesia

name: Plinth Nesting Tables (Set of 2)
description: The Plinth set is two rectangular tables in solid ash, a larger one at 16 inches high and a smaller one that slides underneath, each a simple slab top on two slab legs with a finger-jointed corner. The wood is pale and matte with a white-oil finish that keeps it from yellowing. They pull apart for guests and tuck back together when you want the floor clear.
details: Large: W 32 in x D 18 in x H 16 in; Small: W 24 in x D 15 in x H 13 in
Solid ash, white-pigmented hardwax oil
Finger-jointed corners, no visible hardware
Weight capacity 60 lb each
Arrives assembled
Made in Lithuania

name: Disco Smoked Glass Coffee Table
description: The Disco is a round coffee table with a 12 mm smoked bronze glass top resting on a chunky cylindrical base in chrome-finished steel. The base is a single polished drum, so the whole thing reads like a lamp from 1974 lying on its side. It is reflective, a little chunky, and looks right between a bouclé chair and a shag rug.
details: Dia 36 in x H 15 in
12 mm tempered smoked bronze glass top, flat polished edge
Chrome-plated steel drum base, dia 16 in
Weight capacity 50 lb
Glass sits on clear rubber bumpers; ships in two boxes
Made in China
imageQuery: smoked glass chrome round coffee table

name: Harbor Coffee Table
description: The Harbor is a rectangular coffee table in whitewashed solid acacia with a slatted lower shelf and chunky square legs, finished with a wire-brushed texture that shows the grain through the wash. It looks faded by salt and sun on day one. It suits a bright room with linen, rope and a view, or one that wishes it had one.
details: W 46 in x D 24 in x H 17 in
Solid acacia, wire-brushed with a whitewash stain and matte topcoat
Slatted lower shelf with 1/2 in gaps
Weight capacity 90 lb
Legs attach with four bolts
Made in Vietnam

name: Beam Wall Shelf
description: The Beam is a single floating shelf of solid reclaimed oak, 2 inches thick, held on a pair of raw steel pipe brackets with exposed flange plates. The wood is sanded smooth on top but keeps its checks and old bolt holes along the face. It is a plain, strong shelf for records, cookbooks or a row of jars, and it looks right against brick.
details: W 36 in x D 9 in x H 2 in shelf; brackets project 8 in
Solid reclaimed oak, matte sealed; each board unique
Black-finished 3/4 in steel pipe brackets with flanges
Weight capacity 60 lb when mounted into studs
Mounting screws and drywall anchors included
Shelf made in Pennsylvania; brackets made in India
imageQuery: reclaimed wood pipe bracket wall shelf

name: Fjell Bookcase
description: The Fjell is a tall, open bookcase in solid ash with slim 3/4-inch uprights and five fixed shelves that step back slightly as they rise. There is no back panel, so light passes through and the wall shows behind your books. It is pale, airy and makes a wall of books look organised rather than heavy.
details: W 32 in x D 13 in x H 75 in
Solid ash frame and shelves, white-pigmented hardwax oil
Five fixed shelves, 14 in clearance each
Weight capacity 40 lb per shelf
Anti-tip wall strap included; assembly takes about 30 minutes
Made in Lithuania

name: Kiln Ladder Shelf
description: The Kiln is a leaning ladder shelf with four solid oak shelves set into a black powder-coated steel frame that rests against the wall at a slight angle. The shelves deepen toward the floor, from 6 inches at the top to 14 at the bottom, so a plant or a stack of ceramics fits where it should. It is spare and low-key, and it takes up almost no floor.
details: W 24 in x D 16 in x H 70 in
Solid white oak shelves, oiled; matte black steel frame
Four shelves: 6, 9, 11 and 14 in deep
Weight capacity 30 lb per shelf
Wall anchor included; must be secured
Made in Vietnam

name: Hearth Pine Bookcase
description: The Hearth is a wide, low bookcase in knotty solid pine with a beaded back panel, a scalloped apron and three adjustable shelves behind an open front. It comes in a warm honey wax or a chalky cream paint that is rubbed back at the edges by hand. It is the sort of piece that holds the cookbooks in a kitchen or the games in a family room, and looks like an heirloom either way.
details: W 48 in x D 14 in x H 40 in
Solid knotty pine with beadboard back
Three adjustable shelves on 1 in pin increments
Weight capacity 45 lb per shelf
Arrives assembled; anti-tip strap included
Made in Portugal

name: Palette Lacquered Bookcase
description: The Palette is a tall cube bookcase in a high-gloss lacquer, with sixteen asymmetric compartments of different sizes and a brass-trimmed plinth base. It comes in a glossy oxblood, a saturated cobalt and a bottle green, and it is built to hold a lot of objects at once. It is a bookcase that wants to be the loudest thing in the room, and it is.
details: W 40 in x D 14 in x H 76 in
MDF with eight coats of polyurethane lacquer, hand-polished
Sixteen fixed compartments from 8 x 8 in to 20 x 14 in
Brass-plated steel plinth
Weight capacity 25 lb per compartment; anti-tip strap included
Made in Italy

name: Sahar Jute Rug
description: The Sahar is a hand-braided jute rug with a chunky herringbone weave and a hand-knotted fringe at both ends, in a natural tan with a thin band of terracotta cotton woven near each edge. It is springy underfoot and shows the fibre's natural variation from strand to strand. It layers under a smaller patterned rug or holds its own beneath a rattan chair and a lot of plants.
details: Available in 5 x 8 ft, 8 x 10 ft and 9 x 12 ft
100% jute with cotton accent yarn, hand-braided
Pile height 1/2 in; rug pad recommended
Spot clean with a damp cloth; not for damp rooms
Fibre sheds lightly for the first few weeks
Made in India

name: Nordlys Wool Rug
description: The Nordlys is a flatwoven rug in undyed New Zealand wool, with a fine tone-on-tone pinstripe in pale grey and chalk that only shows up close. It is thin, dense and lies perfectly flat, so doors clear it and chairs slide across it. It is the rug for a room that wants warmth underfoot without adding anything to look at.
details: Available in 5 x 8 ft, 6 x 9 ft and 8 x 10 ft
100% New Zealand wool, handwoven flatweave
Pile height 1/4 in; reversible
Professional clean recommended; blot spills
Low-pile; works under doors and desk chairs
Made in India

name: Tidal Stripe Rug
description: The Tidal is a flatwoven cotton rug with wide, uneven stripes in chambray blue, sand and white, and a short tasselled fringe at each end. The cotton is yarn-dyed and stonewashed, so the colours are already a little faded and the whole thing goes in the washing machine. It suits a bright hallway, a bathroom or a sunroom where a damp towel might land on it.
details: Available in 3 x 5 ft, 4 x 6 ft and 5 x 8 ft
100% cotton, handwoven flatweave, stonewashed
Machine washable cold on gentle; line dry
Pile height 1/4 in; use a non-slip pad on hard floors
Colours may soften slightly after washing
Made in India
imageQuery: blue white striped cotton flatweave rug

name: Meadow Floral Rug
description: The Meadow is a hand-tufted wool rug with a scattered block-printed floral in faded rose, moss and ochre on a cream ground, with a narrow olive border. The pattern is loose and hand-drawn rather than repeated exactly, so it looks like something found at a farm sale. It is soft, thick and warm, and it makes a plain room feel homely at once.
details: Available in 5 x 8 ft, 6 x 9 ft and 8 x 10 ft
100% wool pile, hand-tufted on a cotton backing
Pile height 1/2 in
Vacuum without beater bar; professional clean
Sheds lightly for the first month
Made in India

name: Sunburst Shag Rug
description: The Sunburst is a deep-pile wool shag with a swirl of burnt orange, caramel and cream radiating from off-centre, like a rug pulled from a 1970s conversation pit. The pile is two inches long and springy, so bare feet sink into it. It is warm, loud in the best way and works best with lots of brown wood and low furniture around it.
details: Available in 5 x 8 ft and 8 x 10 ft; round 6 ft
100% wool shag on a cotton backing, hand-tufted
Pile height 2 in
Shake outdoors and vacuum on low; professional clean
Heavy; rug pad recommended on hard floors
Made in India

name: Keystone Geometric Rug
description: The Keystone is a hand-knotted wool and viscose rug with an interlocking fan-and-chevron pattern in emerald and ink, with a fine gold-toned line tracing each shape. The viscose gives the pattern a soft sheen that shifts as you walk around it. It is sharp, formal and built for a room with velvet, brass and a mirror or two.
details: Available in 5 x 8 ft, 6 x 9 ft and 8 x 10 ft
80% wool, 20% viscose, hand-knotted
Pile height 3/8 in
Professional clean only; blot spills immediately
Rug pad recommended
Made in India

name: Mesa Woven Throw
description: The Mesa is a handwoven cotton throw with a stepped diamond pattern in terracotta, rust and cream, finished with long twisted tassels at each end. The weave is a mid-weight dobby with a slightly slubbed hand, so it drapes over a chair arm without sliding off. It is the kind of thing you fold over the sofa and then never actually fold again.
details: 50 x 70 in
100% cotton, handloomed
Twisted tassel fringe, 4 in
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low
Weight 2.2 lb
Made in India

name: Alder Wool Throw
description: The Alder is a brushed lambswool throw in a single pale colour with a narrow blanket-stitched edge and nothing else going on. It is light, warm and soft against the skin, and it comes in light grey, oatmeal and a chalky white. It suits a quiet bedroom or a pale sofa, and it is the first thing you reach for on a cold evening.
details: 55 x 75 in
100% lambswool, brushed
Blanket-stitched edge in matching yarn
Dry clean or hand wash cold and lay flat
Weight 1.8 lb
Made in Portugal

name: Peony Velvet Cushion
description: The Peony is a 20-inch square cushion in a thick cotton velvet with a contrast piped edge, in fuchsia with chartreuse piping, cobalt with coral, and tangerine with plum. The velvet is dense and short-pile, so the colour reads flat and saturated rather than shiny. Pile three on a sofa and they argue with each other in the best way.
details: 20 x 20 in
100% cotton velvet cover with contrast cotton piping
Feather-and-down insert included, 10% down
Hidden zip; cover spot clean or dry clean
Made in India

name: Orchard Gingham Cushion Set (Set of 2)
description: The Orchard set is two 18-inch cushions in a yarn-dyed cotton gingham, one in a small check and one in a large check of the same colour, with a frilled edge and a plain linen back. They come in sage, red and a soft butter yellow, each on cream. They belong on a window seat or a pine bench, and they get softer with every wash.
details: 18 x 18 in, set of two
100% yarn-dyed cotton gingham front, linen-cotton back
1.5 in self-frill edge
Polyester fibre inserts included
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low
Made in Portugal

name: Seaglass Linen Cushion
description: The Seaglass is a 22-inch cushion in a heavyweight stonewashed European linen with a raw, fraying flange edge and a simple tie closure at the back. It comes in a pale sea-green, a washed denim blue and white, all slightly uneven in colour the way good linen is. It looks right against a slipcovered sofa with a window open behind it.
details: 22 x 22 in
100% European linen, stonewashed, 7 oz
1 in raw-edge flange, cotton tie closure
Feather-and-down insert included
Machine wash cold, line dry
Made in Portugal
imageQuery: pale blue linen cushion raw edge

name: Sumi Linen Cushion
description: The Sumi is a rectangular lumbar cushion in a heavy natural linen with a single hand-painted brushstroke in charcoal across the front, so no two are quite the same. The back is plain and the edges are knife-finished with no piping. It is spare, textural and sits well on a low sofa or at the head of a futon.
details: 14 x 24 in lumbar
100% linen, natural, hand-painted with water-based pigment
Feather-and-down insert included
Hidden zip; dry clean only to protect the brushwork
Each piece is unique
Made in Japan

name: Tangerine Bouclé Cushion
description: The Tangerine is a round 18-inch cushion in a nubby wool-blend bouclé with a fabric-covered button pulled into the centre, in burnt orange, chocolate and cream. The looped texture catches light unevenly and feels like a sheep's fleece under your hand. It is a small, chunky, cheerful thing that belongs on a curved chair.
details: 18 in round, 4 in deep
Wool-polyester bouclé cover, centre button
Polyester fibre insert included
Hidden zip; spot clean only
Made in China

name: Rivet Steel Mirror
description: The Rivet is a tall rectangular mirror in a 1-inch blackened steel frame with exposed hex-head rivets at each corner and a lightly distressed, hand-waxed finish. The glass is 5 mm with a bevelled edge, and the whole thing can lean against a wall or hang from heavy-duty D-rings. It is plain, heavy and looks right in a hallway with concrete floors.
details: W 24 in x H 60 in x D 1.5 in
Hot-rolled steel frame, blackened and waxed
5 mm mirror glass with 1/2 in bevel, MDF backing
Two D-ring hangers; can also lean
Weight 42 lb; wall anchors included
Made in India

name: Fan Fluted Brass Mirror
description: The Fan is a half-round wall mirror with a brass frame worked into radiating flutes, so the mirror sits inside a sunburst of ridged metal. The brass is brushed and lacquered to keep its warmth without tarnishing, and the mirror is a clear, high-silver glass. It is a polished, geometric piece for above a console or a fireplace with a velvet chair nearby.
details: W 36 in x H 20 in x D 2 in
Brass-plated steel frame, brushed and lacquered
4 mm mirror glass
Flush-mount keyhole hanger
Weight 14 lb; wall anchors included
Made in India
imageQuery: fluted brass half round wall mirror

name: Arc Walnut Mirror
description: The Arc is an arched wall mirror in a slim solid walnut frame, steam-bent around the top and finished with a hand-rubbed oil that brings out the grain. The frame is just an inch wide, so the shape does the talking. It is warm and organic, and it brings a little mid-century softness to a hallway or above a low sideboard.
details: W 22 in x H 40 in x D 1 in
Solid American walnut frame, steam-bent arch, oiled
4 mm mirror glass with a flat polished edge
Two D-ring hangers
Weight 11 lb
Made in Vietnam

name: Menagerie Print Set (Set of 3)
description: The Menagerie set is three giclée prints of oversized gouache animals, a tiger, a flamingo and a leopard, each on a different saturated ground of cobalt, hot pink and mustard. They come matted in white and framed in a glossy black lacquer that nods at chinoiserie. Hang them in a row or scatter them into a gallery wall that already has too much going on.
details: Three prints, each 16 x 20 in framed, 11 x 14 in image
Archival giclée on 310 gsm cotton rag paper
Gloss black lacquered wood frames with acrylic glazing
White 8-ply mat; sawtooth hangers
Printed in Oregon; framed in Vermont

name: Enso Ink Print
description: The Enso is a single sumi-ink circle printed in large format on heavyweight washi paper, with the brush's dry edges and uneven ink load preserved from the original painting. It is mounted on a solid black-stained oak hanger bar at top and bottom, so it hangs like a scroll with no glass. It is quiet, graphic and gives a wall one thing to look at.
details: W 24 in x H 36 in
Archival pigment print on 120 gsm washi
Solid oak hanger bars, black stain, with cotton cord
No glass; keep out of direct sun and damp
Printed in Japan; bars made in Vietnam
